text: __NOTOC__ Tyler Stockton is a human boy located at the Cathedral Square in Stormwind City. He can be found standing at the base of a tree, to the left of the entrance to the Cathedral of Light. He is likely the brother of Nathan Stockton.
Twin Moonfire was a Balance druid honor talent, available at rank 25.

Twirhp is a Forsaken or dwarf (depending on the race of the player) mage that is a part of the Uber Town group. He can be briefly seen during the flashback of the confrontation with Illidan Stormrage atop the Black Temple.
Tyr's Deliverance is a Holy paladin ability, learned from The Silver Hand (artifact).
Tyrande's Moonstone can be looted from the Time-Lost Keepsake Box.
Tyler Swaptech is a Mechagon mechagnome located on Mechagon Island.
__NOTOC__ Ty Julian is a human located at Stormwind Harbor in Stormwind City.
Twin Friendship Ring is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Twinklestar is a faerie located at Tirna Vaal in Ardenweald.
Twisted Hellchoker is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Twisted Idol is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Twisted Samophlange is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Twins of the Sun Priestess is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of the Twins of the Sun Priestess.
Two of Putrescence is a reagent for Darkmoon Deck: Putrescence.
Two of the Indomitable is a reagent for the Darkmoon Deck: Indomitable.
Two Suns, Two Moons is a book located at Windrunner Spire in the Ghostlands.
Twisting Nether Portal is a portal located in the Breach in the Tomb of Sargeras. Using it teleports the player to the Twisting Nether.
Tyrion is a gnome quest giver located in Stormwind Keep in Stormwind City.

Tyrygosa (also mistakenly spelled Tyrigosa or Tyragosa) is one of the few remaining members of the blue dragonflight and former suitor to Kalecgos. When taking humanoid guise, she has refused to take the form of a human, finding elves more aesthetically pleasing, and seems to prefer not to meddle in the affairs of mortals. Her alias is Tyri, possibly either a nickname given to her by Kalec or a name she goes by when in disguise.

Tyrion's Spybot is a spybot belonging to Tyrion found in Stormwind Keep of Stormwind City. During the quest The Attack!, Spybot will be dressed up in a disguise (becoming Priestess Tyriona) so as to draw out Lord Gregor Lescovar.

Tyrus Blackhorn is a satyr who has been imprisoned at Blackhorn's Penance in Mount Hyjal since Archimonde's defeat at the Battle of Mount Hyjal. Matoclaw states that Blackhorn was once a night elf, but was tempted by the offers of power made by Archimonde and the Burning Legion. He joined their side and was transformed into a satyr. After the battle, Blackhorn was captured and imprisoned at this site for his treachery. Players inadvertently help Tyrus escape the bonds. His whereabouts afterwards are currently unknown.
U-238 Rounds is a pet battle ability available to a small number of pets. It was originally only available to Grunty.
Fired when the unit's mana stype is changed. Occurs when a druid shapeshifts as well as in certain other cases. UNIT_DISPLAYPOWER: unitTarget
__NOTOC__ Tyrantion is a black dragon that can be encountered on Island Expeditions.
Fired when the charged state of a units' combo points changes. UNIT_POWER_POINT_CHARGE: unitTarget
Tyrhold Conduit is provided by Watcher Koranos for The Magic Within in Thaldraszus.
Tyrilla is a dryad found in the Haven Cascades in the Emerald Dream. She is taking the water from a river and pouring it into a moonwell.
Umber is a human quest giver located in Nighthaven in Moonglade. He is the Cenarion Circle's archivist and considered very brilliant by his night elf peers.

Umbral blots are creatures found in the Twisting Nether and are described as mobile spheres of pure void. Mutated umbral blots travel through the Twisting Nether, growing larger every time they consume a physical object. If they grow too large they could threaten all of creation. But this is unlikely an issue as heroes have been known to destroy them.

Ulmat Thondr was a peninsula in the far south of the continent of Azeroth. It was under watch by members of the Order of Tirisfal. During the First War, it was quiet there and there were no signs of orcs, though there was a rise in the number of jungle trolls. A new comet was said to be visible along the southern horizon.
Umbiwa is a jungle troll barmaid of The Filthy Animal inn located in the Sunreaver's Sanctuary within the mage city of Dalaran.

Uldum is the level 83-84 zone of Cataclysm. The full breadcrumb chain to Uldum starts during the Deepholm storyline as soon as players hit level 83. Two quests open up in the player's respective faction's room in the Temple of Earth and involves a few quests at the Twilight Terrace before heading to Stormwind or Orgrimmar to check in, then down to Thistleshrub Valley in Tanaris to meet up with 's caravan. Adarrah's quest, Easy Money, is the required first quest of the zone, as the quests before it are all optional, but they do fill in some of the lore. After completing Easy Money, the storyline proper begins in a phased version of the Lost City of the Tol'vir with Traitors!. After Escape Fro

Ultraxion is the fifth boss to appear in the Dragon Soul raid. He is so monstrous that he cannot land atop Wyrmrest Temple, so players must stand on the ledge and battle him as he flies next to the temple. The damage in the fight is reminiscent of Patchwerk in Naxxramas with just ridiculous amounts of damage; a gear check boss. However, while Patchwerk was a simple tank and spank, Ultraxion has mechanics which can tax the coordination abilities of the raid. World first heroic kill on 25-man achieved 7.12.2011 by Exodus - US-Ysondre.
Umberhowl is a wolf located at Oronok's Farm in Shadowmoon Valley.
Ulzann is a jungle troll food and drink vendor located at the Shattered Landing in Blasted Lands.

Ulna Thresher is a Forsaken follower found at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. Excited by the idea of testing herself on a dangerous planet like , she volunteered to join the Horde forces there early on. After surviving a bloody massacre at the Stonefury Cliffs, she was attacked by a wake of Frostbeak Scavengers, and subsequently joined with her rescuer, a soldier from Frostwall.

The Ultimate Battle-Training Stone is a quest reward from the following quests: *Unearthed Magic *The Very Best *Teamwork Lesson: Krosus *Teamwork Lesson: Skorpyron *Teamwork Lesson: Ursoc *Teamwork Lesson: Xavius *Wailing Critters (quest) This item is also sold by Lio the Lioness/Serr'ah in Dalaran for .
Udder Destruction is an ability used by the Pygmy Cow during a pet battle.

Umbraxis the Cruel was a satyr located at Shala'nir in Val'sharah. He was in charge of preparing Malfurion Stormrage to be corrupted by the power of the Emerald Nightmare. He didn't make it out of the Legion alpha.
Uber Town is an in-universe guild that attacked Illidan Stormrage in the Black Temple.
Ugla the Hag is a Crawliac harpy and one of High Crawliac's three lieutenants, found in the Haglands in Highmountain.
Uhrlia is a succubus that briefly attacks adventurers, upstairs in the Legerdemain Lounge in Dalaran during the quest The Folly of Levia Laurence.

Uldir (pronounced "OOL-deer") is the first raid of Battle for Azeroth, situated in Nazmir. It is entered from the Heart of Darkness, with the door being in the southeastern part of the Altar of Rot. Uldir was a titan research and quarantine facility where the titans conducted experiments on the Old Gods and dissected them to try to understand them. The titans' plan was to kill the Old Gods without ending their host: Azeroth. They ended up accidentally creating something that could potentially wipe out all life on the planet, a fifth Old God named G'huun. It was locked away within Uldir via three seals, each located within the pyramids of Atul'Aman, Nazwatha, and Dazar'alor. With the fall of
The Uldir Teleporters are transportation devices located throught Uldir.
Ulla Skycloven is a Highmountain tauren guild vendor located in the Great Seal in Dazar'alor.
Umbral Guards are night elf ghosts located at the Terrace of the Moon in the Tomb of Sargeras.

Ugh the Feared is a pygmy who can be encountered during Island Expeditions.
Umbral Seers are n'raqi located in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
Uhnish Vwah drops from Dark Inquisitor Xanesh in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
Umbral Brutes are vargul located at Malykriss: The Vile Hold in Icecrown. Empowered versions appeared at the Weeping Quarry during Death Rising.
Umbral Gatekeepers are n'raqi located in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
Ultimate Detainment is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Umbral Ear Trumpet is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

] Unbroken are pink cousins of the underground faceless ones. Though there has been some debates on the lore, the Unbroken seem to be a faction, branch, or subspecies of the faceless ones — a race freed from the underground layers of the planet when Illidan attempted to rip Northrend apart with the Eye of Sargeras. Many believe that the faceless ones and these unbroken are servants of the Old Gods. Within the tunnels of the Inner Kingdom of the ancient nerubian ruins, Arthas and Anub'arak found a forgotten one. Though it has yet to be proven, these creatures may have been small manifestations of the Old Gods trying to break free of their prison. Arthas and Anub'arak defeated it to get to Ice
Una is a tauren leatherworking trainer located in the Thunder Bluff Armorers building on the middle rise in Thunder Bluff. During the feast for the Highmountain tauren, she was trapped by the Void.
Unbound Devastator is a felguard in the Arcatraz. He is immune to enslave and banish.

The Unbound Thicket dominates the eastern half of Crystalsong Forest. It is bordered by Sunreaver's Command to the north, Zul'Drak to the east, Windrunner's Overlook to the south, and the Forlorn Woods to the west. The thicket contains the Ruins of Shandaral just east of the crystal tree. As the name implies, the Unbound wander this area. All the trees are crystal, and great fissures leaking magical energy lace the ground. It's an eerie place where even the wind sighs as it blows through crystal leaves, and all that remains of those Highborne are ghosts and twisted, maddened creatures that'll kill anything they see.
The Uncharted Sea is located in southern Jade Forest. The area is empty, save for a lone unmanned Horde ship found above a convenient underwater mountain, providing safehaven from fatigue.
Unbound Will is a talented warlock ability, available at level 60.
Uncanny Luck is an ability used by pigs during a Pet Battle.

Un'Goro Madness is a micro-event set in Un'Goro Crater, that sees players defeating a range of elite bosses in order to loot Dino Mojo, a special consumable granting a long-duration buff to the player's abilities. Designed to celebrate the release of the Journey to Un'Goro expansion for Hearthstone, the event debuted March 17, 2017, lasting for three days.
Unbound Mists are unbound air elementals located in the Echoing Halls of Highmountain.
Unbridled Ferocity is an Azerite trait available to Fury warriors.

The Unburdened Azerite Timequartz could be purchased for 25 Mark of Honor from in Boralus or in Zuldazar after completing Battlefield Master. Only classes with a healer specialization could purchase it. For characters who had already learned Rank 4 of Blood of the Enemy or Sphere of Suppression, its cost was lowered to 10 Mark of Honor. Infusing the item at the Heart Forge will grant Rank 4 of the Artifice of Time Essence and leave behind a Shattered Timequartz.
Unbreakable Crystalspine is a basilisk located in Island Expeditions.
__NOTOC__ Unbreakable Vortax is a twilight dragonspawn located in Island Expeditions.
Unbreakable Cuffs is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Unceasing Chain Link is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Unbound Fortitude is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Unchained Gladiator: Shadowlands Season 2 is a feat of strength achievement earned by ending Shadowlands PvP Season 2 in the top 0.1% of the 3v3 arena ladder.
Unchained Gladiator's Soul Eater is an achievement reward from Gladiator: Shadowlands Season 2. Obtaining this mount also awards the Feat of Strength Unchained Gladiator's Soul Eater (achievement).
Unchained Gladiator's Badge of Ferocity is sold by Zo'sorg in Oribos for .
Unchained Aspirant's Badge of Ferocity is sold by Purveyor Zo'kuul in Oribos for .
Unbridled Swarm is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of the Unbridled Swarm.

The Underworld Minions were servants of the naga sea witch Zar'jira on and below one or more of the Darkspear Islands near the Maelstrom. Thrall, his warriors, and a group of humans were captured by them during the Third War. Their goal was to end the Darkspear tribe.

The Undead Pillagers were a faction within the undead Scourge during the Third War in Northrend. The Hearthglen villagers that transformed into zombies were a part of the faction. One group was attacking a dwarven expedition. With the help of Arthas and his men from Lordaeron, Muradin and his dwarves destroyed the base. A second group was attacking Arthas's base camp during the attack on Mal'Ganis.
Undercity Reservist's Cap is a quest reward from Oran's Gratitude.

__NOTOC__ Undead Ravagers are skeletons who roam the Valley of Bones in Desolace. They can also be summoned by Outcast Necromancers. The Outcast Necromancers' ability to summon them calls them Magram Ravager, indicating that they are intended to be undead centaur of the Magram clan, even though they use the normal two-legged skeleton model.
Underbelly Whelp Scales dropped from Black Dragon Whelps and Snarlflare in Redridge Mountains.
Undeath Deck is an item that begins the quest Darkmoon Undeath Deck, which rewards the player with a .

The Underhalls is a vrykul hall built into the mountain on the southeastern end of Valhalas, in Jotunheim in northwest Icecrown. It is aa dank place filled with bones and rotting flesh and vargul. The Hall of Horrors and the Circle of Suffering are found here. The vargul are generally exiled here after failing the ring at Valhalas, and were used for experiments by Dr. Terrible, including Bethod Feigr, who sought out vengeance for his betrayal. During the war against the Lich King, The Bone Witch sent the adventurers here to find out information about what the Doctor was up to, notably by beating out his apprentice Osterkilgr. They later found out what Dr. Terrible had done with the corpses o
Undercity Commendation Badges may be purchased from for a cost of one Champion's Writ.

The Undershell is a big cave directly under L'ghorek in the Abyssal Depths. Its entrance is located in the Scalding Chasm. Inside the cavern there are three powerful ogre magi — Ur'Goz, Sku'Bu, and Neph'Lahim — maintaining a ritual that connects L'ghorek to an immense unnamed creature far below. The cavern is also filled with Nether Fiends, which were summoned from the netherworld by the ogre magi to defend them.
Undercity Writs of Commendation are sold by Zen'Vorka at Malfurion's Breach in the Molten Front for .
This map contains many of the points of interest within Undercity.
Underground Spiders are small spiders found in the tunnels beneath Gilneas City leading into Aderic's Repose in Gilneas.
Uncle Gus is a pandaren found in the Summer's Rest inn, inside the Shrine of Two Moons. He seems to like telling jokes.

The Uncrowned is a secret organization of rogues led by the Shadows, their leaders, who form the Council of Shadows. The Uncrowned fight the Burning Legion alongside the other class orders during the demons' third invasion, and their order hall is the secret Hall of Shadows located in the sewers of Dalaran. Ranks of the Uncrowned include members of Ravenholdt, Deathstalkers, SI:7, Shattered Hand, Steamwheedle Cartel, Shado-Pan, Bloodsail Buccaneers, Hidden Circle, Gnomeregan Covert Ops, Royal Apothecary Society, and once of the Defias Brotherhood.
__NOTOC__ Underlight Crusaders are murlocs found on the Gloaming Reef islands off the coast of Val'sharah.
The Underlight Sentry can be found on the Gloaming Reef islands off the coast of Val'sharah.

The Understone tribe is a powerful drogbar tribe led by Dargrul the Underking. The tribe makes its home in Neltharion's Lair, and uses Understone Breach as an entrance. They share space with the Mightstone tribe.
Undercity Mages are Forsaken mages located at the Stair of Destiny in Hellfire Peninsula.
Undercity "Skull Shocker" is sold by Charles Gastly in Orgrimmar and Brigade Members in Boralus. This one can make undead get drunk.

__NOTOC__ Uncrowned Peacekeepers are guards located in the Hall of Shadows and in the Vindicaar. They also briefly appeared when the Uncrowned, led by Valeera Sanguinar, secured the Legerdemain Lounge during the search for Akaari Shadowgore.
Underlight Sorcerors are deep sea murlocs located at the Gloaming Reef islands off the coast of Val'sharah during Fish Frenzy.
Underlight Deepfeeders are deep sea murlocs located at the Gloaming Reef islands off the coast of Val'sharah during Fish Frenzy.
Underlight Tadpole are murlocs located at the Gloaming Reef islands off the coast of Val'sharah during Fish Frenzy.
Underlight Supplicants are murlocs located at the Gloaming Reef islands off the coast of Val'sharah.
The Underlight Herald is a deep sea murlocs located at the Gloaming Reef islands off the coast of Val'sharah during Fish Frenzy.

Undulating Boneslimes are oozes found in Lostlight Grotto in Val'sharah. They are also summoned by Boneflux. These reddish oozes were created by the Moonlost Owlbeasts by melting down the bodies of captured Dryads.
__NOTOC__ Understone Breachers are drogbar located in Highmountain.
__NOTOC__ Understone Earthrenders are earth elemental furies located in Highmountain.
Undercurrent is a fishing ability granted by the Underlight Angler. It is linked to the Bloodfishing trait.
Undead dragon mounts are flying mounts first added to World of Warcraft with Wrath of the Lich King.
The Undercity Plaguebat is a giant bat that transports Horde players to the Gates of Orgrimmar at the end of The Battle for Lordaeron (Horde).
The Undersea Hills is the name of a picture in The Art of World of Warcraft. It is the drawing of a mountainous area under the sea.
The Uncorrupted Voidwing was a quest reward from Lost Flight.
Undercity Champions are Forsaken located at the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown during the Scourge assault in Death Rising.
Darkness Rising is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Undead Bone Ash is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Undertaker's Crown is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Undercity Banner is sold by at the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown for .

Unholy Power is a talent in the Demonology tree, you will need to spend 20 points in Demonology to max it. It increases the damage done by your Voidwalker, Succubus, Felhunter and Felguard's melee attacks and your Imp's Firebolt by 20% at max rank.
Unleashed Rage is a passive specialization ability for Enhancement shamans, available at level 42. It is a raid-wide buff that increases attack speed of all nearby party and raid members.

The Unfinished Painting is a depiction of Azeroth's twin moons located inside the Scarlet Bastion in Stratholme. Behind this one is hidden Of Love and Family, a painting by Artist Renfray, that she placed there following Tirion's trial for protecting the orc Eitrigg, as she knew that she could no longer let the painting visible to everyone. Years later, Crusade Commander Eligor Dawnbringer asked adventurers to collect the real painting behind and bring it to him, explaining that it is a painting of great personal value to Highlord Tirion Fordring.

Unholy Frenzy (originally called Hysteria) was an Unholy death knight ability that allowed the caster to send an allied party or raid member into a killing frenzy for 30 sec. It could be used on players, pets, or even the death knight themself. __NOTOC__

Universal Explorer is an achievement that requires the character to uncover all segments of all the regional maps of the world. Completing the achievement awards the title The Explorer and an additional . Along the way, you will have also received the Tabard of the Explorer for exploring Northrend and for a total of 94 achievements. Due to impassable terrain in the Storm Peaks and Icecrown, it is extremely difficult to get this achievement without Cold Weather Flying, unless you have a Warlock and Friends ready to summon you, or the X-53 Touring Rocket mount.

Unit S is a group that includes twelve soldiers who were gathered together to storm a Scourge ziggurat outside a plagued nerubian city. They were formed by Counselor Talbot, the same 'man' who chose Thassarian to be their leader. Private Brau deserted from the unit and said that in his opinion, the "S" stood for "suicide". He is now being held prisoner inside the Inner Hold in Valiance Keep. It is unknown what the "S" really stands for, but Old Man Colburn says that it "ought to be named after a town" just like Unit Darkshire and Unit Goldshire. As soon as Unit S landed, they were ambushed by the Scourge. They eventually discovered that one of the soldiers in the unit was actually a spy for
Unega is a tauren flight master located at Hunter's Hill in Southern Barrens.

Unleash Elements is an Enhancement shaman ability available at level 81, which simultaneously triggers Unleash Wind and Unleash Flame, increasing the shaman's attack speed by 60% for the next 6 swings and damage done by the next fire spell by 40%.
Unleash Flame is an Elemental shaman ability available at level 81. It increases the damage of the shaman's next fire spell by 40%.
Unleash Life is a Restoration shaman talent. It instantly heals the target for a certain amount and empowers the shaman's next direct healing spell. It is an exclusive choice node with Undulation.

__NOTOC__ The Unearthed Grounds was an Explorers' League excavation site found just north of the Greatwood Vale and east of the Northwatch Expedition Base Camp in Stonetalon Mountains. The area was forcibly taken by the Horde from the dwarves that were working it.

Unga Ingoo is the southern island comprising Nayeli Lagoon in south-central Krasarang Wilds. The Cradle of Chi-Ji is to the northwest and Marista is to the northeast. It is the southernmost land in Pandaria, which also makes it the most southernmost landmass accessible to players on Azeroth.
Unholy Ascension is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
Unharnessed Powers are Lightning elementals fought at the Pinnacle of Storms in the Throne of Thunder during the Lei Shen encounter.

United We Stand is an achievement earned from freeing 10 captured guards in Shattrath City, Talador. The NPCs are called Captive Sha'tari Peacekeeper and Captive Sunsworn Honor Guard, and can only be freed whilst on the quest Assault on Shattrath Harbor.
Unleashed Power is a demon hunter class talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Chaos Fragments.

The Unethical Adventurers are a vignette that appear at the entrance of a Snowblind Mesa cave in Highmountain when a player attempts to loot the Seemingly Unguarded Treasure. Upon being killed, the adventurers drop a wrist item that changes depending on the player's class and armor type: Darkful's Mitts (cloth), Zenobia's Handwraps (cloth), Jak's Gloves (leather), Lysander's Lovindle Bracers (mail) and Xander's Gauntlets (plate). Unlabeled Potion is a reward from Throwing SI:7 Off the Trail: Highmountain.
Unholy Determination was a feats of strength achievement earned for killing all red dragons in the Ruby Sanctum during the death knight quest Draconic Secrets.
Unknowable Cubes have a chance to drop from mobs on Mechagon Island during Ideas Can Come from Anywhere.
Unguent Caress drops from Ra-den the Despoiled in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
Unlocking the Power can be picked up in Boralus or Dazar'alor after reaching Heart of Azeroth level 70.
Unliving Champions are Scourge trolls located in Island Expeditions.
Unfiltered Bone Broth is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

Two Unlocking Obelisks flank the entrance into the Sepulcher of Knowledge in Maldraxxus. Anima from the valley's two Power Crystals needs to be directed through the Activated Necrocrystals and into both of the Obelisks in order to open the way into the tower.

Unka is the younger sister of the tuskarr Taruka. She is an energetic child who was desperate to repair and fly Taruka's old kite, and Taruka hoped to earn enough knots to buy kite silk for her from the hoarder Warrak. The night before their clan began their journey to Kamagua, Unka, Taruka, and their mother Makusha had a dinner which, as often happened, was not a happy occasion. Unka sulked because Taruka hadn't earned enough knots to buy her kite silk, and Makusha barely ate before she resumed working on an undershirt, a slower way of earning knots. Taruka declared that she would catch enough fish on the way to Kamagua to buy the kite silk, as well as tusk polish for Makusha. Unka covered

Unearthed Teleporter Sigil can be found on the corpses of all creatures in Korthia, more likely on rare and rare-elite enemies (for Conquering Korthia), and inside other Relic Fragment-containing lootables around the zone. Turn the item to Archivist Roh-Suir at the Reliquary of Remembrance of Keeper's Respite for 8 Cataloged Research and 4 reputation with the Archivists' Codex.
Unhindered Soul is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Unfaltering Sandals is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
The Unholy Gem is provided as an objective for In Service of the Unholy. When filled with the powers of Duke Vallenhal, it turns into a Filled Unholy Gem.
Unhinged is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of the Unhinged.

__NOTOC__ Unseen were invisible mobs that haunted Raven Hill in Duskwood and the Ruins of Lordaeron in Undercity. They were neutral unless attacked, but since they were invisible to the naked eye most players were totally unaware of their existence. Warlocks who could cast Detect Invisibility, or other players using various means to detect invisible mobs, could see them. In addition, they did not become visible when provoked. Since they were invisible and neutral, they were generally not a threat to players. However, to any class with an AoE spell they could be extremely dangerous as they were level 49-51 and Duskwood was an 18-30 zone, so any players who encountered them were very likely to
Unstoppable Aggressor's Ring is an epic ring for melee DPS classes.
Unstable Mana Crystal can be found in Unstable Mana Crystal Crates in the Ruins of Silvermoon of Eversong Woods.

]] Unstoppable Abominations are abominations summoned in Kel'Thuzad's Chamber during the Kel'Thuzad encounter of Naxxramas. This mob is also for the achievement Just Can't Get Enough (10 player)/Just Can't Get Enough (25 player).
Unstable Mana Crystal Crates are located throughout the Ruins of Silvermoon in Eversong Woods.

Unng Ak was the spokesman for all the furbolg packs gathered by Krasus and Rhonin to help the night elves in their fight against the Burning Legion. He was of the Blackmaw tribe. During a battle in Azshara, Krasus informed him that Huln Highmountain and his tauren would be coming to help, although Unng Ak wasn't sure they would and thus did not place all of his hope on that. After Huln arrived and personally helped to take down many demons, Unng Ak expressed his gratitude. Cenarius had previously sent Eche'ro to Unng Ak with a message asking for Huln, but after the delivery, Unng Ak could hear the moose involved in some sort of battle. Informing Huln of the message, he requested that he assi
Unrefined Power Crystals are looted from Arcane Crystals and Jorune Crystals in Jorune Mine in Talador.
Unluckydos were sold for by Bump-On-A-Log and Stick-In-The-Mud during Island Expeditions.
Unmanned Darktide Rylakinator-3000 are goblin shredders located in Darktide Roost in . They are activated by Rylakinator-3000 Power Cell. One is seen being attacked by rats.

The Unstable Solenoid is part of the technology used in the operation of the Sky Shark. This particular solenoid can be found in the main wreckage in the Jade Forest and prompts players to hunt down the other solenoids to destroy them, lest they fall into enemy hands.
Unshackled Waveray is a fathom ray flying mount that can be purchased from Finder Pruc in Nazjatar for after reaching with the Unshackled.
Unstable Irradiated Golem is a slag elemental located on Mechagon Island.
Unpowered Arcane Sentinels are nightborne constructs located in Nyell's Workshop in Suramar. They become active when Master Artificer Nyell channels the nearby pylon.
Unstoppable Undead is a pet battle achievement earned by defeating the corrupted pets of Argus with all Undead pets.
Untamed Ferocity is an Azerite trait available to Feral druids.
Unstable Phantasma Lure is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Unstoppable Zealot's Legplates drop from Sergeant Bainbridge in the Siege of Boralus.
Unnatural Claws is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

The Uplands is a region with hills in northwestern Alterac Mountains. It was the bread basket of the kingdom of Alterac, but after the destruction of the core of that nation, the Uplands fell under the control of the Syndicate, who have several camps in the area. This area is where they are strongest. Baron Vardus could be found here. Dandred's Fold is found in the westernmost part of the Uplands. No quests take place here anymore and this area no longer serves any purpose.
Ursius is a polar bear found in the Moon Horror Den in Winterspring. According to Francis Morcott, he is the first to eat chimaera and owlbear in his pack when they hunt.

The Upper Sumprushes can be found in central Townlong Steppes, bordered by the Longying Outpost to the north, Dampsoil Burrow to the east, the south-central great tree and Dusklight Hollow to the south, and the Lower Sumprushes to the west. The Osul Mist-Shaman make their base on the big island in the center of the swamp, while Dmong Naruuk can be found overlooking the lower sumprushes just southwest of the pond, and Jahesh of Osul can be found to the east in the shadow of Hatred's Vice.

Use the Force(s) is an achievement earned by completing the Cenarius encounter in the Emerald Nightmare instance without cleansing the adds which spawn during the fight, on Normal difficulty or higher. During the encounter, Cenarius will summon adds in the form of dryads, treants, wisps, and drakes. Any of these adds may be cleansed during the fight through Malfurion Stormrage's Cleansing Ground ability that he casts, which will transform them into Allies of Nature that can aid the raid group. To obtain the achievement, ensure that none of these adds are cleansed before defeating Cenarius.

Urgent Message from Ardenweald is a animated object located at various locations in the Shadowlands. The scroll starts two quests of the Chains of Domination campaign: A Cry From the Heart and Magical Mystery Tour!, and will follow the player around until the quests are picked up. An Urgent Message unit also has a fixed spawn location in Keeper's Respite of Korthia for the first quest, and in the Exoramas of Maldraxxus for the second, just in case.

The Vale of Beasts is a small clearing in the midst of Ashenvale Forest. In this place, the flows of magic work strangely on animals and monsters, causing those creatures to congregate peacefully. The nearby night elves call this the Congress of Beasts and have learned to avoid it, for they have discovered that the co-existence of the beasts does not extend to humanoids. The Beast pattern is drawn from this ley line.
V'eru is a naaru who resides within Shattrath City at the Terrace of Light, not far from the portal trainer and its fellow Naaru, A'dal.
Uther's Strength is a random world drop from level 45 - 63 mobs.

Utgarde Keep (pronounced OOT-ghaard) is the name of a keep which is the location of two dungeons in World of Warcraft, as well as the first dungeon of the same keep (see below). The keep is located on the shores of Lake Cauldros in the Howling Fjord of Northrend. It was built into the fjord this region was named for, so it's got a lake at its feet and a waterfall tumbling down the cliffs on either side. Utgarde is inhabited by the vrykul, led by King Ymiron, bent on proving their strength to the Lich King, who will raise the most worthy of their warriors to serve him beyond the grave. Enemy encounters within the keep include vrykul, their minions (such as worgs), and various types of undead.

Val'zareq the Conqueror is a blood elf found in Shadowmoon Valley, east of Eclipse Point. He is the head of the Crimson Sigil and is one of Illidan's greatest of followers outside of the Black Temple.

The Valley of Spirits is a long narrow valley that leads from the Valley of Strength to the Talon Gate in Orgrimmar. It is the long-standing seat of the Darkspear trolls.

The Valley of Fangs is a small valley between two massive stone formations located in the central Badlands. It is the location of one of the many small quest camps in the region, this one containing Martek the Exiled, Rigglefuzz, and Jazzrik. Travel through the valley can be hazardous as it is home to both wolves and cougars. During the Cataclysm, the valley was destroyed by Deathwing as it lies directly in the path of destruction that makes up the Scar of the Worldbreaker.

.]] .]] The Valley of Heroes is a valley that lies before Stormwind Gate. A bridge of stone crosses the narrow moat and is the first sight of all who enter. This gloriously lush valley lies south of the city, and many visitors must pass through it, as it is one of three entrances to Stormwind (the others are the Deeprun Tram, and the Stormwind Harbor). The statues of five famous Alliance heroes stand on either side of the path, welcoming visitors while providing an awe-inspiring warning. The valley is also the location of several important Stormwind officials. The Valley of the Watchers is an area in southern Tanaris that once held an impenetrable gate into Uldum. However, the Cataclysm sundered the gates, and in the process woke up several titan creations that now guard the area. Sandstone Golems can be found rampaging about where the elite Dune Smasher mountain giants used to be.

The Valley of the Bloodfuries was a planned subzone in the Stonetalon Mountains. It could have been an early name for the Charred Vale or a part of it, as it is the only area inhabited by the Bloodfury harpies in Stonetalon.

Valiance Keep is the major Alliance settlement in the Borean Tundra similar to Warsong Hold for the Horde. It is a fortified town that covers two islands, with a barracks, an inn and a large icebreaker in its harbor, at the center of the town. The Alliance icebreaker, The Kraken, keeps the town connected to Stormwind Harbor; and the sound of its bell as it arrives or departs makes a lonely echo in the tundra's constant wind. __NOTOC__ Valok the Righteous is a draenei member of the Argent Dawn and was taken prisoner by the Scarlet Crusade in the Scarlet Enclave. When the death knights of Acherus invaded the Enclave, the prisoners traded owners. He speaks of the planet Argus and how he remembers it which puts him of an age over 13,000 years. On Argus, Valok was among the eredar who gathered in Eredath when Kil'jaeden told them about Sargeras. He wondered what Sargeras could bring that the eredar did not already have. Draenei death knights have a chance to execute Valok.

The Valley of Fallen Heroes is a valley located between Aldur'thar: The Desolation Gate and Corp'rethar: The Horror Gate in Icecrown. It would appear from the Scourge ground activity that any fallen champion or hero of the Alliance or Horde are killed and resurrected as champions of the Scourge instead. They are led or controlled by high ranking necromancers and val'kyr. The fallen heroes aren't the only dangers here though, there are also countless frost wyrms, flesh giants, and risen skeletons armed to the teeth. The Valley of Echoes is usually the first area adventurers will visit in their journey into Icecrown. Located in the southeasternmost area, it can be entered through a naturally forming ramp from Crystalsong Forest or through flight. During the war against the Lich King, the Argent Vanguard was the first forward base established by the Argent Crusade when they breached Icecrown under the command of Highlord Tirion Fordring. Located in the Valley of Echoes, it gave them a path into Scourgeholme, which the highlord hoped to conquer and remake into an Argent Crusade fortress.

__NOTOC__ Valhalas is a battle pit at the northern end of Jotunheim in northwest Icecrown. The pit is decorated by wooden dragon heads and overseen by a Val'kyr named Geirrvif and Gjonner the Merciless. Opposite Valhalas is an entrance cut into the mountain, which leads to the Underhalls, a dank place filled with bones and rotting flesh and vargul. Valhalas is named after the Vrykul word for the Halls of Valor, where the worthy souls of fallen vrykul go after death. Muradin Bronzebeard believes that it is a deliberate perversion of the name, done after the vrykul of Northrend turned their backs on the keepers. :Renowned for its tranquil farmlands and bustling breweries, the Valley of the Four Winds is a land rich with fertile soil and pristine waters. Although this thriving heartland's residents are plagued by virmen and other pests, they face an even greater threat from the savage mantid of the nearby Dread Wastes. Valley of the Four Winds is a tranquil plain of lush farmland, bordered by dense mysterious jungles along the south and impassable mountains to the north. The valley is considered the "breadbasket" of Pandaria, but the year’s harvest is in jeopardy and a terrible malaise has overcome the pandaren that live along the coast. The valley is also the home of the legendary Stormstout Brewery

The Valley of Emperors is the final resting place of several mogu emperors (and at least one of the hozen emperors as well). It can be accessed from the west via the unnamed mountain path from One Keg up to the Neverest Basecamp, or from the east via the Howlingwind Trail's unnamed northern extension above the Howlingwind Cavern. Mogu and members of the Zandalari have reached the valley in an effort to raise the Thunder King. From the valley's lower, eastern, end, the five crypts in the valley are: the Tomb of Shadows, the Tomb of Secrets, the Tomb of Conquerors, the Shrine of the Merciless One, and Emperor Rikktik's Rest.

The Vale of Eternal Blossoms storyline begins at level 87 in Kun-Lai Summit at the Temple of the White Tiger. A short quest chain pays off with the opening of the Gate of the August Celestials for the first time in generations! After that, breadcrumbs open up to daily quests elsewhere on the continent once adventurers reach level 90. The actual storyline plays out whenever players gain a reputation level with the Golden Lotus faction. Daily quests for the Golden Lotus start at the Golden Pagoda underneath the two mogu statues on the east side of the zone. The progression of the Golden Lotus storyline is tracked in the achievement Eternally in the Vale.

]] Valor's Edge is an Alliance warship that took part in Operation: Shieldwall during the campaign in Pandaria. It was involved in the bombardment and assault on the Horde's Domination Point in the Krasarang Wilds along with two other battleships, one of whom was the Defiant, and the Skyfire gunship. Commanded by Captain Mulkey, the Valor's Edge and its accompanying vessels continued to put pressure on the Horde Dominance Offensive for the duration of the battle in the region, despite the risk of nearby mines. Horde forces would target the ship's captain as part of an effort to destroy the Alliance's leadership in the conflict.
Valkyra Shieldmaidens are vrykul who briefly appear in Skyhold after recruiting them as Class Hall followers (warrior only).
